title: The Journey to Luoyang

lesson.themeZh: 勇气与合作、胜利后的反转，以及战争对百姓和都城的破坏
learningObjectivesZh: 按顺序复述关羽与华雄交战、联军在虎牢关遭遇吕布、三兄弟联手战斗的经过
理解吕布由强势到撤退的转折及三兄弟合作的作用
结合老妇人的话解释洛阳被焚及皇帝被带走的结局

sections.title: Guan Yu's Swift Victory
sections.summaryZh: 关羽向华雄挑战，躲开长矛并将其斩断。刘备在帐中担心关羽安危；关羽获胜归来，华雄部下撤退，他端起仍然温热的酒杯，曹操称赞他的勇武。

sections.title: A Dangerous Challenge at Hulao Pass
sections.summaryZh: 十八路联军向洛阳推进，却在虎牢关被董卓率领的大军阻挡。吕布骑着赤兔马出现，其他将领最初不敢上前，随后数名出战的将领接连被吕布击倒。

sections.title: The Three Brothers Fight Together
sections.summaryZh: 张飞先与吕布交战，关羽随后加入，刘备也赶来援助。三兄弟合力围攻，吕布渐渐气喘疲惫，最终下令撤退。董卓的军队随之退回洛阳，联军欢呼获胜。

sections.title: The Ruins of Luoyang
sections.summaryZh: 联军继续前进，途中刘备看见远处洛阳方向燃起大火。次日到达时，众人发现都城已化为废墟。一位老妇人告诉张飞，董卓焚毁城市，带走幸存者和皇帝。

Hua Xiong's soldiers were retreating after the fight.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 战斗结束后，华雄的士兵正在撤退。

vocabulary.example: The armies felt hopeful as they marched toward Luoyang.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 联军向洛阳进发时充满希望。

vocabulary.example: Dong Zhuo's army blocked the road at Hulao Pass.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 董卓的大军在虎牢关阻挡了去路。

vocabulary.example: Liu Bei heard neighing before Lu Bu appeared.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 吕布出现前，刘备听到了马嘶声。

vocabulary.example: The three brothers circled Lu Bu during the battle.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 战斗中三兄弟围住了吕布。

vocabulary.example: Lu Bu kept fending off the brothers' weapons.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 吕布不断招架三兄弟的兵器。

vocabulary.example: Lu Bu ordered his soldiers to retreat.
Liu Bei noticed fires blazing in the distance.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 刘备注意到远处熊熊燃烧的大火。

vocabulary.example: Luoyang was reduced to smoking rubble.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 洛阳化成了一片冒烟的废墟。

vocabulary.example: The woman said Dong Zhuo took away the survivors.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 老妇人说董卓带走了幸存者。

vocabulary.example: The emperor had been taken from the city.

questions.question: How did Guan Yu respond when Hua Xiong attacked him with a spear?

options.text: He asked Liu Bei to fight in his place.
He dodged the spear and sliced it with his blade.
He hid behind the soldiers until Hua Xiong left.
He threw his own weapon away and ran.

questions.explanation: 第4段明确写到华雄用长矛刺来时，关羽先躲开攻击，再用自己的兵器将长矛斩断；其他三项均未发生。

questions.question: What stopped the 18 armies as they approached Luoyang?

options.text: A river that had flooded the road.
A broken bridge with no way across.
A huge army led by Dong Zhuo at Hulao Pass.
A storm that forced them to return home.

questions.explanation: 联军抵达虎牢关时，前方出现由董卓率领的大军，挡住通往洛阳的道路，而不是河水、断桥或暴风雨。

questions.question: What happened to the generals who fought Lu Bu before Zhang Fei joined the battle?

options.text: Lu Bu knocked them down one after another.
They persuaded Lu Bu to surrender.
They defeated Lu Bu and took his horse.
They refused to leave their tents.

questions.explanation: 第17至19段先写将领们犹豫，之后有人出战，但吕布击倒了第一名将领，也击倒了后来上前挑战的人；投降、夺马和始终不出帐均不符。

questions.question: Why did Lu Bu finally retreat from the battle?

options.text: Dong Zhuo ordered him to guard the capital before the fighting began.
His horse ran away without him.
The 18 armies had already reached Luoyang.
He grew tired while fighting Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, and Liu Bei together.

questions.explanation: 张飞、关羽、刘备依次加入战斗，三人合力围攻。第24至27段写吕布气喘、张飞指出他累了，三兄弟再度进攻后吕布才转身撤退。

questions.question: What did the old woman say had happened in Luoyang?

options.text: The emperor had won the battle and welcomed the armies.
A fire had started accidentally, but everyone stayed safe.
Dong Zhuo had burned the city and taken the survivors and emperor away.
Lu Bu had rebuilt the city after the fighting.

questions.explanation: 第35段中老妇人明确说明董卓放火烧城，把幸存者带走，甚至把皇帝也带走；其余选项与她的叙述不符。
